_README: Hand-curated TBC-content-phase overrides for recipes that the
Used in build_authoritative_data.py's emit_recipe_file — wins over the
att_phase_map.json value for the same spell.
Each entry: spell_id (string key) -> { phase, source, verified_by, name }.
phase 1 = TBC launch (always visible); 2 = SSC/TK; 3 = BT/Hyjal;
4 = Sunwell/MgT. A phase-1 override effectively un-hides a recipe the
ATT data wrongly gated behind a later phase.
Why misclassifications happen: ATT derives phase from an `awp` patch tag
or a reputation gate, which sometimes reflects when the recipe's DATA was
last touched rather than when it became obtainable. World-drop formulas
available since TBC launch can end up tagged Phase 4 this way.
_comment_boots_enchants_phase1: BoE world-drop boots enchant formulas — available since TBC launch (Phase 1), ATT wrongly tagged them Phase 4.
